summary: VRRM at -47.4% drawdown is NOT a 'distressed liar' — financials clean, FY2025 strong, ICFR effective, no going-concern. The bear case is operational: Q1 2026 revenue went from +11% growth (FY25) to FLAT, with Commercial Services -3.5% (travel-demand softness, RAC concentration). Largest single finding is FORM-4 ABSENCE: in March 2020 COVID drawdown, CEO Roberts personally bought open-market at $8; in the current -47% drawdown, the same CEO has executed ZERO code-P purchases, only RSU/PSU vesting and tax withholding. Capital-return continues at corporate level ($50.7M Q1 2026 buyback) but the insider/issuer asymmetry is a soft negative signal. Also: 33% director-withhold vote on Rexford, $72M NYCDOT receivable, undisclosed new contract pricing. Verdict: NEUTRAL leaning slightly negative — fundamentals real but momentum broken with no insider confidence backing; would not classify as honesty-alpha SHORT (no lying) but no LONG-tier conviction signal either.
